title: Abba Shaul of Beit Marmesha

paragraphs: Yuchasin records that he was unique in his generation and a disciple-colleague of R' Yochanan ben Zakkai. Hyman suggests that perhaps this was its author's reading in Avot, chapter 2, mishnah 8.[^1]

notes.text: דריב״ז is contextually Yochanan ben Zakkai, but its title remains R' without an exact named title occurrence bound here. Abba is explicit and Marmesha transliterated, without identity/place binding. תלמיד חבר is disciple-colleague, not fellow-disciple or student alone. Yuchasin is the supplied short title, without verified author/edition. ואפשר preserves Hyman’s tentative explanation of the reported version; its author is the natural antecedent of גרסתו, but the compressed pronoun does not exclude another referent. Uniqueness/relationship and possible Avot 2m 8 reading remain source reports, not historical admission.
